summary.purpose: Consume durable order.confirmed RabbitMQ messages, send order-confirmation emails via an HTTP provider, and persist delivery state in PostgreSQL.
data: PostgreSQL table notification_deliveries (event_id, order_id, payload JSONB, status, attempts, last_error, updated_at)
Configuration: DATABASE_URL, RABBITMQ_URL, EMAIL_PROVIDER_URL, PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_MS, PORT
Inbound message schema: eventId, orderId, customerEmail, totalCents, trackingNumber
flow: Upsert notification_deliveries and acquire advisory lock on hashtext(eventId)
If pending, POST /email to HTTP provider with Idempotency-Key header
Persist final status, attempts, and last error to PostgreSQL
Ack sent messages or nack without requeue to dead-letter exhausted/invalid messages
unknowns: Email provider defaults to mock-provider:8080 with no documented production service ID or contract beyond Idempotency-Key deduplication.
GET /api/notifications is explicitly unauthenticated, creating a potential security conflict if exposed beyond private networks.
No compensation or rollback exists for email failures against confirmed orders.
Dead messages lack automatic or manual replay implementation.
